fix.assertion: India's nuclear weapons can be used only on the authorisation of the country's civilian political leadership.
fix.reason: The Political Council of the Nuclear Command Authority, chaired by the Prime Minister, is the sole body empowered to authorise the use of nuclear weapons.
fix.explanation: Both are true and R explains A: the Political Council, chaired by the Prime Minister, is the only body that can authorise nuclear use, which is what makes the decision civilian-controlled.
